Spanish extended word lengths: accepted spellings are generated from the
RLA-es 2.9 es-MX affix and dictionary files. The project offers GPL 3+, LGPL 3+
or MPL 1.1+; this distribution uses MPL 1.1. The original notices, license,
dictionary and affix source files are in ../es-MX/. Pinned upstream revision:
ea82c1214ead57740798acf66a1e18e5ac874c41.

Answer selection uses spelling-frequency data from wordfreq 3.0.2, by Robyn
Speer and contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0), plus selected Spanish Wiktionary entries
by Wiktionary contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0), extracted by Wiktextract and
published by Kaikki. English equivalents are copied from those Wiktionary entries.
Source links on each displayed meaning lead to the relevant article and history;
exact per-entry revisions are not supplied by the extract. No inferred meanings,
examples or quotations are included. The new selection and English equivalents
have not been individually reviewed; source coverage, word-frequency, sense
labels and regional applicability are incomplete.

https://kaikki.org/dictionary/downloads/es/es-extract.jsonl.gz
